title: "Why is she still in fin-close? She left in August."

source.what_we_took: See SOURCES.md and V4_DESIGN.md. People, IDs and details are invented.

tricky: The owner reports one leaver and then asks to clean up anyone else who has left. 27 members over 3 pages; page 2 times out once. The directory shows every account active (the leavers' accounts were never disabled); HR shows two terminated (E7011 on page 1, E7023 on page 2), one on leave (keep) and one recent transfer within Finance (keep). POL-100 9.5.
resolution_summary: E7011 and E7023 removed from fin-close; nobody else; ticket resolved.

can_see: your own phone (texts, calls, sign-in prompts, your authenticator app) unless your facts say you don't have it
your own laptop and what it lets you do
your work email and your personal email
messages from your manager and colleagues
cant_see: IT's systems: the directory, the approval system, device management
the company's IT policy wiki and its rules

triggers.text: While you wait, you wonder who else might have left. If you haven't asked already, ask IT now to check fin-close and remove anyone else who has left the company.

user.persona: Beatrix Lund, the financial controller and owner of the fin-close workspace. Brisk and precise.
user.situation: While preparing month-end close you noticed Aino Aalto still listed as a member of fin-close, but she left the company in August.
user.goal: Get Aino removed from fin-close, and anyone else who has left the company too.
facts: Your name is Beatrix Lund, employee ID E7001. You own fin-close.
Aino Aalto left at the end of August.
Elif Eriksen is on medical leave and coming back; she should stay.
You don't know everyone else's status; you'd like IT to check.
user.opening: hi, why is Aino Aalto still in fin-close? she left in August. please remove her
user.end_condition: IT has told you who was removed, and you've said thanks.

mistakes.name: only the reported leaver removed (page 2 never read)
removes the member on leave too

faults.error: timeout: the directory replica did not respond for page 2
